verdict.rationale: JumpCloud has a dedicated HRIS integration feature explicitly for automating onboarding/offboarding from HR source of truth, plus broader identity lifecycle automation and directory sync claims, but evidence doesn't detail specific HRIS platforms supported, mover/attribute-change handling, or app-assignment automation triggered by HR changes, and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of this specific feature. missing for 10: named HRIS integrations supported, detail on mover/attribute-sync (not just joiner/leaver), evidence of automatic app-assignment changes tied to HR events, and independent validation of the HRIS integration itself.
